text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          model: gpt-4o-mini
          prompt: |
            You are a moderator. Detect spam and AI-generated content in the following text. 
            If the content is spam, respond with "spam". If it is AI-generated, respond with "ai-generated". 
            Otherwise respond with "none".
          max-tokens: 10
```
